rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person’s ability to recover from setbacks or withstand severe pressure.

example.english: Facing setback after setback, they gradually got back on their feet through resilience.
example.traditional: 面對接二連三嘅挫折，佢靠住抗逆力慢慢振作返。
example.jyutping: min6 deoi3 zip3 ji6 lin4 saam1 ge3 co3 zit3 keoi5 kaau3 zyu6 kong3 jik6 lik6 maan6 maan2 zan3 zok3 faan2

rows.note: Use this specifically for a material’s ability to return to its original shape after being stretched or deformed.

example.english: This rubber band has good resilience and returns to its original shape after being stretched.
example.traditional: 呢條橡筋彈性好，拉長咗都可以縮返原狀。
example.jyutping: ne1 tiu4 zoeng6 gan1 daan6 sing3 hou2 laai1 coeng4 zo2 dou1 ho2 ji5 suk1 faan2 jyun4 zong6

rows.note: Use this mainly for an organization or system’s capacity to recover and resume functioning after a disruption.

example.english: After the backup system was activated, the bank’s resilience allowed services to return to normal quickly.
example.traditional: 備用系統啟動後，銀行嘅復原力令服務好快恢復正常。
example.jyutping: bei6 jung6 hai6 tung2 kai2 dung6 hau6 ngan4 hong4 ge3 fuk6 jyun4 lik6 ling6 fuk6 mou6 hou2 faai3 fui1 fuk6 zing3 soeng4
